comment: Picture 1 (and its small copy) is the schematic, pictures 5 and 6 are a photo of the original pedal's PCB; picture 3 is the perfboard layout sheet (populated board with board-mounted pots, wiring diagram, underside, etch mask). Read from the populated board, confirmed against the wiring diagram. The layout adds a 1N5817 and a second 100uF for the supply that the schematic does not draw.
